audiencePolicy: All looks and products in this build are for men. New CMS records default to him and the CMS locks the audience to him.
rules: Use explicit galleryImages only for additional photographs of the exact same look; never substitute unrelated product, stock, or related-look images into its look gallery.
Uploaded look cover files are saved to public/images/looks/<slug>.<ext>; additional views are saved as <slug>-02.<ext> through sequentially numbered filenames.
Product images are optional but can be uploaded through the local CMS.
Retailer search URLs and listed prices in this starter are editable placeholders; replace them with specific tracked affiliate product URLs and verify current pricing before launch.
Local CMS binds only to 127.0.0.1. Every JSON save creates a timestamped backup.

The CMS taxonomy focuses on evergreen menswear search intents: everyday, work, interview, date night, campus, travel, activewear, weddings, family gatherings and formal events. Festival names are not used as taxonomy options or navigation categories.
